title: Green Eggs and Ham
author: Dr. Seuss
summary: A persistent character keeps offering green eggs and ham to a grumpy one who refuses to try them in any place or manner. Written with a very small vocabulary, it ends when the doubter finally tastes them.
readIf: you want a rhyming, repetitive book for early readers or read-aloud time.
skipIf: you want a story with much variety or detailed illustrations.
